nodes.label: Oak Tree Paradox
nodes.source_file: pastebin/textual/Footpaths and Fences_ A Guide to Mosaic and Column Rights.md
nodes.rationale: A mature oak tree has high life value (supports 284 insect species) but zero financial value until dead — this paradox drives the entire Barbets Duet mission to invent markets that reward living ecosystems

nodes.label: Column Rights Model
nodes.source_file: pastebin/textual/Footpaths and Fences_ A Guide to Mosaic and Column Rights.md
nodes.rationale: Western/US model where one owner controls a vertical column from earth core to atmosphere — uses fences for exclusion, optimises for extraction, incentivises resource depletion over stewardship

nodes.label: Mosaic Rights Model
nodes.source_file: pastebin/textual/Footpaths and Fences_ A Guide to Mosaic and Column Rights.md
nodes.rationale: African traditional inclusive land tenure where multiple stakeholders hold rights to specific benefits on shared land — uses footpaths over fences, yields high social equity and high biodiversity

nodes.label: Jumuiya (Community with Shared Vision)
nodes.source_file: pastebin/textual/Footpaths and Fences_ A Guide to Mosaic and Column Rights.md
nodes.rationale: Swahili concept for a community with shared vision, values, and goals — the organisational and governance structure of the Barbets Duet network, replacing hierarchical control with social capital

nodes.label: 7 Principles of a Barbet Learning Site
nodes.source_file: pastebin/textual/Footpaths and Fences_ A Guide to Mosaic and Column Rights.md
nodes.rationale: Distilled at 2010 Nkoroi Partners Meeting: Consistency with Site, Learning by Demonstration, Just Begin, Thinking Step-by-Step, Immediate Needs, Path of Least Resistance, Utu Net Benefits

nodes.label: Utu (Humanity/Personhood)
nodes.source_file: pastebin/textual/Footpaths and Fences_ A Guide to Mosaic and Column Rights.md
nodes.rationale: Kiswahili concept of humanity — net benefits must flow simultaneously to individual, community, and environment; the ethical success metric for all learning site activity
